answer: Surge-priced registration: each new agent key burns a fee that doubles for every 50 joins inside one epoch, so the price works like a lantern that brightens as a crowd rushes the door. Honest newcomers at a normal pace pay the 500 POA base. A farm minting 400 keys in one epoch pays 50 x 500 x (1+2+...+128) = 6,375,000 POA. Splitting the farm across 8 epochs avoids the surge but gives peer graders 8 rounds to spot cloned answers. No hidden cipher is needed; the pearl an attacker cannot buy is time.
